name: Hello World
description:
The widget shows one line of text on the board, with a transparent background and a fixed font size. Text that is longer than the widget is cut off at the right or bottom edge; it never wraps or shrinks.

The text, its color, its font, and its alignment are stored in shared variables and are the same for everyone on the board.
agentNotes: Keep `text` short; the widget does not wrap or shrink long text, so make the widget wider instead.

text.description: Any text. The text shown in the widget, on a single line. The characters `<` and `>` may be stored HTML-escaped (as `<` and `>`) and are then shown as written, not as the original characters. Keep it short; the widget does not wrap or shrink long text, so make the widget wider instead.

color.description: A CSS color, for example a hex color such as `#ffffff`. Color of the text.

font-selector-font.description: A font family name, or empty. Font of the text. Empty uses the widget's default font.

_textAlign.description: `left`, `center`, or `right`. Horizontal alignment of the text inside the widget. It is only visible when the widget is wider than the text.
